175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.encoding: original/expanded/flat/piArgs contain whole-token IDs. Look up classes by id for equalsPrefix/dotPrefix. Whole-token, equalsPrefix and dotPrefix are separate namespaces; compare within the required namespace only. An absent prefix never matches.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.tokens: Compare operation.metadata.commandTokens: one row token matches ANY equal ID in flat; multiple row tokens match consecutive equal IDs in flat. flat preserves command/wrapper expansion order and quoted-token boundaries. Distinct IDs never match; no substring, fuzzy matching or command regex.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.dd_output: An expanded command head equals row.head and an argument class has equalsPrefix equal row.equalsPrefix.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.mkfs: A flat token equals row.exact or its class dotPrefix equals row.dotPrefix.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.find_delete: An expanded command head equals row.head and an argument equals row.arg.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.find_exec_rm: An expanded command head equals row.head and an argument row.rm occurs after the first row.exec argument.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.remote_script_to_shell: Two adjacent original commands have heads in row.downloaders then row.shells; any separator counts.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.base64_decode_to_shell: Two adjacent original commands have heads row.head then one of row.shells, and the first has an argument in row.decodeArgs.
175e2cd3710728e2918006af078066b690ba007f.pi_credential_output: A piArgs sequence starts row.auth then a row.printActions ID, or starts row.auth,row.check and contains row.credentials.
